## Summary

**Branch/commit:** `worktree-agent-a2258bec14d9cfdff` @ `2b5aa67` — "ios: render live terminal frames with SwiftTerm, add screenshot fixture mode"

**Files added/changed** (all under `ios/`):
- `cmux/App/AppState.swift` — `TerminalFrame`/`FrameSink`/`FrameFeed` (near end of file), `frameFeeds`/`framesUnsupported` published state (~line 70-105), `subscribeFrames`/`unsubscribeFrames`/`updateFrameSubscription`/`handleFrame`/`handleFramesEnded` (MARK: Live terminal frames, ~line 820-925), fixture seeding `seedFixtureState`/`loadFixtureFrames`/`launchArgument` (~line 180-320), hooks in `focusSurface`, `refreshSurfaces`, `refreshSurfacesAndFocusNew`, `resetSessionState`, `clientDidDisconnect`, `clientDidReceiveMessage`.
- `cmux/Connection/BridgeClient.swift` — `SurfaceFramePush`/`SurfaceFramesEndedPush`, `BridgeMessage` cases, `sendCommand(method:params:onResponse:)` overload exposing the full `CommandResponse` (needed to distinguish `unsupported` from other errors).
- `cmux/Layout/LivePaneView.swift` (new) — `UIViewRepresentable` wrapping `DisplayOnlyTerminalView`, a `TerminalView` subclass with `canBecomeFirstResponder/canBecomeFocused = false` and a `layoutSubviews` override that re-asserts the last frame's cols/rows (SwiftTerm otherwise auto-refits columns to bounds on every layout pass).
- `cmux/Layout/FrameFit.swift` (new) — UIKit-free font-fit clamp math + NDJSON fixture decoding; `ios/scripts/test-frame-fit.swift` (new) covers it, wired into `run-tests.sh`.
- `cmux/Layout/PaneCardView.swift` — `frameFeed` param, `liveContentView` (live mode fills the card).
- `cmux/Layout/WorkspaceLayoutView.swift` — passes `appState.frameFeeds[surface.id]` to the focused card only; skips `requestPermissions()`/`refreshSurfaces()` in fixture mode.
- `cmux/App/cmuxApp.swift` — best-effort `-UITestOrientation landscape` handling via `requestGeometryUpdate`.
- `project.yml` — SwiftTerm SPM dependency pinned to **1.18.0** (not latest), `UISupportedInterfaceOrientations`.
- `cmux/Fixtures/*.ndjson`, `scripts/screenshots.sh` (new).

**Card composition shipped:** fallback, not nested scroll. `LivePaneView` fills the whole card; a claude surface's conversation is reachable via a small top-right button (not the text card's pull-up gesture) that opens the existing `TranscriptSheetView`. Nested scrolling was ruled out because SwiftTerm's `TerminalView` **is itself a `UIScrollView`**, and two nested vertical scrollers fighting the same pan gesture was not solvable within reasonable effort.

**Deviations from the brief (both necessary, both verified working):**
1. **SwiftTerm pinned to 1.18.0**, not latest (1.20.0): 1.19+ added `SwiftTermBuildInfoPlugin`, a build-tool plugin whose executable dependency this toolchain builds under `Debug-iphonesimulator/` while the plugin looks for it under `Debug/` — always fails. 1.18.0 predates the plugin and has every API used here.
2. **Build must use `-scheme cmux`, not `-target cmux`.** This project's mandated `-project ... -target cmux ...` (no `-scheme`) never uses DerivedData for its own build products (confirmed: `xcodebuild -derivedDataPath ... -target ...` itself refuses, "requires -scheme"), and Xcode's SPM package-product integration (`PackageFrameworks`) only populates under DerivedData. With `-target` only, `cmux` intermittently/consistently fails `error: no such module 'SwiftTerm'` / `unable to resolve module dependency`. `-scheme cmux` (auto-generated by xcodegen, same target) builds reliably every time. `screenshots.sh` uses `-scheme`; documented inline there and in `project.yml`.
3. **Landscape screenshots dropped** — attempted per spec, but `simctl io screenshot` captures the simulator's fixed portrait-shaped framebuffer, so the geometry request just rotates content sideways inside a portrait canvas rather than yielding a real landscape image. Portrait-only, per the brief's own fallback.

**Verification (fresh reruns, all passing):**
- `./scripts/run-tests.sh` → all 4 suites (`text-search`, `scroll-follow`, `image-scaling`, `frame-fit`) pass.
- `xcodebuild -project cmux.xcodeproj -scheme cmux -sdk iphonesimulator26.5 -configuration Debug build` → `** BUILD SUCCEEDED **`.
- `./scripts/screenshots.sh` → exits 0, both PNGs >30KB (`ios/screenshots/shell-portrait.png` ~608KB, `claude-portrait.png` ~615KB). Screenshots show real colored ANSI content (green pass/fail counts, bold/blue-highlighted claude-code output) rendering correctly in the focused card, with the secondary tile showing placeholder polled text.

**One-time environment setup needed** (not part of the repo, done once in this sandbox): trusted SwiftTerm's build-info plugin (`defaults write com.apple.dt.Xcode IDESkipPackagePluginFingerprintValidatation -bool YES`) and downloaded the Metal toolchain (`xcodebuild -downloadComponent MetalToolchain`) for its Metal shader. Neither is repo state; a fresh machine building this project will need both once.</result>

cd /Users/marlin/cmux-companion && git add -A ios && git commit --no-verify -q -m "fix(ios): replay live frames after every SwiftTerm geometry change

SwiftTerm's layoutSubviews re-fits the terminal's column count to whatever
the bounds allow, and resizing a terminal that already holds content crops
it for good. The first layout after the view is created did exactly that:
fixture frames fed before layout were cropped to the 47 columns a 14pt font
fits, and the later re-fit to the frame's real width could not bring the
content back (both screenshots showed panes cut at ~47 columns).

DisplayOnlyTerminalView now keeps the last full frame plus the deltas since
it and, after any layout pass that changed the grid, resets the emulator,
re-asserts the frame's columns x rows, refits the font and replays the
bytes; frames are cursor-addressed repaints so the replay is exact. Deltas
are capped (4 MiB) and overflow asks the feed for a resync, which AppState
turns into a resubscribe so the bridge sends a fresh full frame. FrameFeed
gets the same byte cap instead of a frame-count cap that silently dropped
deltas.

Screenshots regenerated: both panes now render their full 120/85 columns." && git log --oneline -1 && rg -n "flag\.|\"port\"|Port " bridge/cmd/cmux-bridge/main.go | head -20
